parameters.name: SpaceId
parameters.description: The project workspace ID (Id). You can call [GetLhSpaceByName](~~424379~~) to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description: The tenant ID. You can call [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~) to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description: The user ID. You can call [ListUsers](~~141938~~) or [GetUser](~~147098~~) to obtain this parameter.
